text: しかし　どうじょうの　かんばん　…　だけは！
note: In dōjō-yaburi the winner traditionally takes the defeated school's wooden name signboard (かんばん) as a trophy, which disgraces the school. The English game calls it an "emblem".
claim: In dōjō-yaburi, the victorious challenger traditionally takes the defeated dojo's signboard (kanban) as a trophy.

check.quote: 看板を取られた道場側は廃業するか、看板を金品を払って買い戻さねばならない。
check.note: In dōjō-yaburi the winner traditionally takes the defeated school's name signboard (かんばん) as a trophy; a school that lost its sign had to close or pay to get it back. The English game calls it an "emblem".
